data.title: Request regression loop for voice/text requests
data.description: scripts/request_eval.py runs ~36 spoken-style requests (Oda food, catalogue, repairs, questions, follow-ups, edge cases) against an isolated backend (temp DB, no email/WhatsApp/Notion, never approves). Fixes so far (uncommitted on Anders' Mac): grocery validation normalises a redundant top-level quantity instead of asking to clarify; config.model() gives the Anthropic client 6 retries so Wi-Fi blips don't fail requests.
